patterns.note: Content is presented in full-width sections with a consistent maximum content width, centered horizontally, often featuring asymmetrical arrangements of text and supporting visuals.
Headings use a large, bold sans-serif font for impact, while body text is a highly legible, slightly lighter weight sans-serif, creating a clear typographic hierarchy.
The site primarily uses a high-contrast dark text on a light, almost white, background, with a vibrant orange serving as the primary accent color for calls to action and key highlights.
A large, abstract background graphic subtly parallaxes, moving slower than the foreground content, creating a sense of depth as the user scrolls down the page.
Sections of content are revealed with a gentle slide-up and fade-in animation as they enter the viewport, guiding the user's attention through the page.
The homepage features a prominent social proof section immediately after the hero, displaying a grid of well-known company logos to build trust early.

technique_notes: A sticky header transitions its height and background color from transparent to solid dark after a short scroll, providing persistent navigation in a compact form.

Content sections are animated into view using scroll-triggered effects, likely leveraging `locomotive-scroll` to detect viewport entry and apply CSS keyframe animations for a subtle fade-up or slide-in.
A large, abstract background element is set to parallax, moving at a slower rate than the main content as the user scrolls, creating a dynamic sense of depth without distracting from the information.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with standard, legible body text and smaller, often uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: subtle; buttons and cards have gently rounded corners.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a more compact, grid-like density for feature lists and logo walls.

standout: The site's distinctive feature is its use of a large, abstract, and subtly parallaxing background graphic that provides visual interest and depth without competing with the content. This, combined with a very clean, almost stark, content presentation, creates a sophisticated and modern feel that avoids generic marketing aesthetics.
